story.title: US citizen charged after GrapheneOS phone wipes during airport search

draft:
I'm watching with interest as a US citizen is charged after his GrapheneOS phone wiped itself during an airport search. 
The phone's automatic wipe feature was triggered by the search, highlighting the tension between security and privacy. 
This case raises questions about device security and user rights. 
What are the implications for phone security in situations like this?
#GrapheneOS #PhoneSecurity #PrivacyRights
